texts.preamble: Jitendra Verma vs State Of M.P on 30 October, 2025 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:27374 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Gwalior Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Amit Seth On The 30th Of October, 2025 Writ Petition No. 4592 of 2012 Jitendra Verma Versus State Of M.P And Others Appearance:
texts.facts: He submits that subsequently vide Gazette NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:27374 2 WP-4592-2012 Notification dated 30.08.2013, the concerned District Judge has been notified as the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal.
texts.arguments: 1. The instant writ petition, filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, challenges the order dated 11.06.2012 (Annexure P/1) passed by the Adjudication Officer-cum-Additional District Magistrate under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 whereby, the petitioner has been held guilty for selling substandard Mava and has been imposed a fine of Rs.5,00,000/-. 2.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that at the relevant time, when the instant petition was filed, no appellate authority in terms of Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 was notified and therefore, this writ petition was filed challenging the order dated 11.06.2012 passed by the Adjudication Officer-cum-Additional District Magistrate, Morena. 3. He further submits that since the consideration of the writ petition involves the adjudication of disputed questions of fact, he may be permitted to avail the remedy of appeal before the appellate authority. However, he submits that while entertaining the writ petition, this Court passed a conditional interim order staying the effect and operation of the impugned order, subject to deposit of 25% of the penalty amount. He submits that the penalty amount of Rs.1,25,000/- has been deposited by the petitioner and the stay is operating in the petition since then.
